name: playwright
description: Automate browser tasks with Playwright, routing between the two interfaces by context cost. The `playwright-cli` path writes the accessibility snapshot to a file and returns a path (402 bytes against 33,011 inlined by MCP on the same page) while keeping full interaction and cross-invocation state. The MCP server is reserved for loops that need the model to reason over page structure turn by turn: exploratory automation, self-healing tests, long autonomous sessions.
